statement: Model of a cited Deleuze reading: distinct problems share actual solutions; nondegenerate singular points are isolated (inverse function theorem)

Hauntology as branching time: lost futures accumulate (lost_mono), branching haunts every later moment (haunted_of_branch), capitalist realism as a modal claim (capitalist_realism); no axioms; models a cited reading of Fisher only

One frame (models of cited readings, no claim about the authors or circuits): in a tree of decisions a lost route is at once Fisher-lost for ever, Hegel-determinate (one definite point of difference), the trace of a Beauvoir-free moment, the present's barbarian with no common moment, and lost along every Camus ascent (unified); in any partial order loss is permanent iff lost pairs never meet again (permanence_iff_no_reconciliation)

Seven one-NOT board rows encoded as a Fisher frame (names and statuses are data copied from the boards, not checked): refuted rows C2, C4, L5 are lost futures of the present A4-A7-A10-BottomPay and stay lost under any continuation (lost_mono applied); every reachable future passes through A4 (capitalist_realism applied)

Levels as a projection: 'some preimage has S' and 'every preimage has S' agree for all S iff the projection is injective (collapse_iff_injective); for the finite-table-to-Phi projection at n=2 they differ for some S (level_gap, from P3's virtualOf_not_injective). Formal analogy only

Not found: a theorem for Beauvoir's 'to will oneself free is to will others free' (a tree frame has no shared future for incomparable selves; a frame with joins loses lost_mono), a model of master and slave beyond non-recognition, and Lawvere's adjoint cylinder between the repository's levels. No text by Beauvoir titled 'The Barbarians' found; the word is Barres's, in her 1926 diary (search summaries only)

Seven hand-coded one-NOT board rows as a Fisher frame, after the review renames (supersedes 8474b92a, old name board_realism). Holds for that tree only; the real history is a DAG (see boards/tasks/philosophy-formal.md).

Not proved: the Coffman-Kundu-Wootters inequality (needs mixed-state concurrence), min-cut = entanglement entropy for HaPPY states, contraction of a general tensor network to the factorised form. Not fitting: symmetric entropy cannot tell recognition from domination; a partial trace is not a death; barbarian-as-spacelike is not permanent in a causal set with diamonds

Lacan's Borromean knot computed as a link, in exact integer arithmetic. Three-ellipse Borromean rings: every linking number 0 and Milnor's triple number mu(RSI) = mu(SIR) = mu(IRS) = -1, by two independent methods (Magnus expansion of the longitudes; Seifert-disc triple point). Any single R-S crossing change (16 cases): lk(R,S) = +-1 and I unlinked from both. Bing double of one ring, four rings R,S,I,Sigma: every lk = 0, every mu(ijk) = 0, mu(RSI;Sigma) = +1, so each three-ring sublink is link-homotopically trivial and the four rings cannot be separated. Trefoil: 9 Fox 3-colourings against 3. Facts about links only; not a clinical claim.

Tree against rhizome over all 33,867 labelled graphs on at most 6 vertices: a connected graph is a tree iff every edge is a bridge; adding one edge to a tree frees exactly the edges of the cycle it closes; connected bridgeless graphs number 1, 0, 1, 10, 253, 11968 for 1..6 vertices.
